hook_styles: Character-specific scene hook (Jinx finally loses her mind).
The moment + exact action (The moment Ashitaka stopped an entire war).
Why + a precise character beat (Why David could not stop the cyberpsychosis).
Short past-tense observation (He Stopped Both Swords / Peace Was Never Option).
Love: a quiet specific feeling (She brought the sun just for him).
Avoid generic greatest/villain lines and cloned titles already on the channel.
caption_styles: Use cinematic serif fonts for a premium look.
Place subtitles in the lower third with semi-transparent backgrounds.
Keep text minimal and ensure it does not block the main action.
Use white text with a subtle drop shadow for readability on all backgrounds.

our_insights: 25-27 Nov window: scene-specific hooks won (Cyberpunk David 3985, Mononoke 'stopped an entire war' 3876, John Wick 'Reminds Them Who He Is' 1741). Generic lines flopped (Gladiator 'Never Leaves A Witness' 53 after a same-day Gladiator repeat).
Love format is still strong (9 of 10 love Shorts over 1,000; Weathering and Kaiju No. 8 both crossed in this window), but this window's biggest spikes were character-specific action beats at 24-27s.
Do not re-queue a hook or title already on the channel (Jinx, David cyberpsychosis, Wednesday, Thorfinn). Same franchise twice in a day hurts (two Gladiator posts 26 Nov).
24-27s remains the sweet spot. 06:30, 18:30 and 22:30 IST stay the liveliest slots. Animal clips are stalled under 1,000 — stop adding more Animal slots.
Keep official scene clips only, video centered, no crop. GTA 6 official gameplay stays gated until launch.
